author: L3xu
quote: The most incredible story ever, I still cannot believe the devs came up with all these ideas back in 1998 that still hold up strong today, after almost 30 years... Twilight Princess used to be my personal undisputed number 1 game since 2009 when I first got the chance to play it, but now its tied with Ocarina of Time Remake. What a journey it has been! It's hands down a must-play whether you play it in a couple of years, or in 30 more. Truly a timeless masterpiece!
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
